CustomField.description: When no keyword rule matches a field's name/label/data type, but the field's own Compliance Group equals this record's ComplianceGroup__c, this record's PIIFieldType__c is returned as a fallback. If more than one Field Type shares the same Compliance Group, only flag one of them as the fallback representative - otherwise the fallback match is ambiguous and the first one encountered wins.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this to make this Field Type the fallback classification used when a field only matches by Compliance Group, not by name/label/data type.
CustomField.label: Is Compliance Group Fallback
